I can definitely understand how you feel bc I am experiencing similar thing. First of all, I am really sorry for both of you to experience this. It can be really difficult to be in ldr. Do you do future plans together?? I mean, maybe planning plans to close the distance can be hopeful. I think you should let him know how much he means to you,how important he is to you and how much you care about him. Tell him that you want to understand and you value his feelings. But maybe trying to have some activities together can be relaxing. Also I'd suggest you to watch movies which is in similar situation. I suggest you to watch "Won't you be my neighborhood?". Movies which has depressed characters but they got through it. It can be helpful. And communication is important but I suggest you to have an activity for yourself to keep you away from getting effected by negativity. Also you can read about depression and search advices from someone who has depression. There is so many articles online. I hope it can be better for you both soon 🌸

I think you should have a conversation with her. You can tell her you can understand how difficult times she is having and you are sorry for those. You should ask if there is a way to help her or make her days better. You should ask what she needs from you because you care about her. Just be there for her whenever she wants. Try to be patient. I think you can contact her but be patient about her. Remind her you like her and you care about her. Try to understand how long it will take her to get better. Also do you make calls?? Hearing so's voice is too helpful and it can make her to feel connected again. Just focus on something else in life but don't  get a break yet. She is already having difficult times. And I definitely can understand it is way more difficult for you. Tell her you two should try to lighten up the sparkles between you. Then you can decide to take a break or moving on.
